AdditionalDetails.Value: XXXX Gold is a classic Australian mid-strength beer, brewed with high-quality Australian ingredients for a refreshing, smooth taste. This easy-drinking lager is a go-to choice for beer lovers who enjoy a crisp, balanced flavour with a touch of malt sweetness and a mild, clean bitterness. Perfect for any occasion, XXXX Gold is a sessionable beer that’s loved across Queensland and throughout Australia. Flavour Profile Taste: Light bitterness with a subtle malt sweetness. Aroma: Mild hops with a smooth, malty finish Mouthfeel: Crisp, clean, and refreshing. Perfect for those who prefer a full-flavoured, mid-strength beer. Crisp and refreshing lager, great for warm Australian weather. Ideal with BBQs, seafood, and pub-style meals.

AdditionalDetails.Name: webdescriptionshort
AdditionalDetails.Value: Since 1890, Mahou has been at the heart of Madrid’s beer culture, growing alongside the city to become Spain’s number one beer and the most awarded Spanish beer range in the world. Brewed to capture the authentic taste and spirit of Madrid, Mahou Cinco Estrellas is crafted using carefully selected malt and hops varieties, its signature yeast, and high-quality water, delivering a premium lager that has satisfied discerning beer drinkers for generations. Mahou Cinco Estrellas pours a bright golden colour and offers fresh, slightly fruity aromas of banana and apple, complemented by delicate floral hop notes. Full-bodied and well-balanced, it delivers a smooth palate with moderate bitterness and a subtle acidity, creating a refreshing and memorable drinking experience. With 5.5% ABV and 27 IBU, it is the iconic taste of Madrid, enjoyed around the world.

AdditionalDetails.Name: webdescriptionshort
AdditionalDetails.Value: Crafted with over 150 years of German brewing expertise, DAB Low Carb delivers full refreshment with a lighter profile. Brewed in Dortmund, Germany, this easy-drinking lager is low in carbohydrates and calories, with 4.0% ABV, making it the ideal choice for relaxed occasions, watching the game, or firing up the BBQ with friends. Pouring a bright pale gold, DAB Low Carb offers subtle aromas of citrus, noble hops and light malt. The palate is crisp and balanced, with a clean, refreshing finish that keeps you coming back for more. Founded in 1868, Dortmunder Actien-Brauerei (DAB) is renowned for brewing award-winning beers that showcase authentic German quality and craftsmanship, enjoyed by beer lovers around the world.
